Name: Jonbow's Animals
Author: J0NB0W
Description:
This is my first published mod, I don't quite understand shading fully yet I may come back and try to make the sprites a bit better. Feel free to improve on the sprites I would love to see someone's take who knows more than I do! I plan on making many more animals in the future! If you have any suggestions or find any bugs put them in the Posts tab.

Adds 4 varieties of Kangaroo to barns. They bring Tea leaves and produce Fur which can be made into cloth though is more profitable if sold.

Porcupines to barns. They bring Apples and produce quills which can be made into Refined Quartz with a recycling machine though is more profitable if sold.

Zebra to barns. They bring Amaranth and produce Zebra Fur which can be made into cloth or sold.

Rhinos to barns. They find Clay and Rock Clumps which can be placed in the recycling machine for 50 stone.

Anteaters to barns. They bring bug meat and bug meat clumps which can be processed into many more but meat or sold.

Antelopes to barns. They bring grass starters and shed their horns which can be refined into quartz.

Giraffe to barns. They bring Pomegranates and fiber bundles which can be processed into many fiber.

 Hippo to barns. They bring Pumpkins and Yams.

Moose to barns. They bring Powder Mellon and shed antlers which can be refined into quartz.

Okapi to barns. They bring clay and clay clumps which can be broken down into many more clay.

Pangolin to barns. They bring Rhubarb and scales which can be processed into quartz.

Tapir to barns. They bring Common Mushrooms and Magma caps.

Lyrebirds to coops. They produce eggs  which can be made into mayo and feathers just sold for now.

Kiwi to coops. They produce eggs which can be made into mayo.

Bilbies to coops. They will bring you mushrooms.

Jerboas to coops. They bring Fiddlehead Fern and Artichokes.

Quokka to coops. They bring Broccoli and Beets.

Also adds an animal tent which can house 8 animals.

More to come let me know if there is any specific animal wanted that hasn't been made by someone else yet!


Turn them on and off in the config default is True for all.

You can find my Insects as farm animals here: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28711]Jonbow's Insects[/url]
